title: Complete algebraic devissage over a prime
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings with $S$ generated by finitely many elements as an $R$-algebra, let $\mathfrak r\subset R$ be prime, and let $N$ be a finite $S$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. A complete dévissage of $N/S/R$ over $\mathfrak r$ consists of a finite sequence of commutative $R$-algebras $A_i,B_i$, finite $A_i$-modules $M_i$, nonnegative integers $r_i$, and $B_i$-linear maps $\alpha_i:B_i^{\oplus r_i}\to M_i$ for $1\le i\le n$, with the following data and conditions. There are $R$-algebra maps $S\to A_1$, $B_i\to A_i$, and $B_i\to A_{i+1}$ for $i<n$; the first and third kinds of map are surjective and of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], and $A_i$ is finite as a $B_i$-module. The map $\operatorname{Spec}B_i\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] with geometrically irreducible fibres [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. The ideal $\mathfrak p_i=\mathfrak rB_i$ is prime and $\alpha_i\otimes_{B_i}\kappa(\mathfrak p_i):\kappa(\mathfrak p_i)^{\oplus r_i}\to M_i\otimes_{B_i}\kappa(\mathfrak p_i)$ is an isomorphism. There are compatible module isomorphisms $N\cong M_1$ over $S$ and $\operatorname{coker}(\alpha_i)\cong M_{i+1}$ over $B_i$ for $i<n$, and $\operatorname{coker}(\alpha_n)=0$. Here cokernel is the quotient by the image, and each scalar action is induced by the displayed ring maps. The sequence of length zero is allowed for $N=0$. Affine spectra, tensor products and residue fields are those of [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] and [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime].
